label: What the owner has to change when mail fails

params.name: auth_rejected
params.default: The mail server rejected that username and password.

params.name: auth_rejected_gmail
params.default: The mail server rejected that username and password. With Gmail you must use a 16-character App Password, not your normal password, and 2-Step Verification has to be on for the account. Make one at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

params.name: sender_refused
params.default: The server refused to send as "{from_email}". It usually has to be the same mailbox you signed in with, or an alias it owns.

params.name: recipient_refused
params.default: The server would not accept that recipient address.

params.name: timeout
params.default: No answer from {host}:{port} within {timeout}s. Check the port, and whether the host's firewall allows outbound mail.

params.name: tls
params.default: TLS failed. Port 587 wants Security = starttls; port 465 wants Security = ssl. They are not interchangeable.

params.name: not_configured
params.default: No mail server is set up for this portal yet.

description_nl: One sentence per kind of SMTP failure, instead of what the library called it. Python only says which kind happened and whether the server is Gmail. {from_email}, {host}, {port}, {timeout}, {error}, {kind} fill in.
